summary: Sonida Senior Living filed an 8-K to voluntarily provide updated unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial statements giving effect to its completed acquisition of CNL Healthcare Properties. The filing includes pro forma statements of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 and six months ended June 30, 2026, for illustrative purposes only. It notes the acquisition closed on March 11, 2026, pursuant to a merger agreement dated November 4, 2025. No new terms, prices, or recommendations are included. The filing is supplemental financial disclosure, not a new special-situation event. What to watch: integration progress and future quarterly results reflecting the combined company.
